package.name: kontrolem_controller_example
package.description: A minimal OUT-OF-TREE Kontrol'Em control law (M16 acceptance). It implements the kontrolem_control::Controller contract, ships its own ControllerFactory, exports it via pluginlib, and is selected with `control_law: example` — with zero edits to kontrolem_ros2_control or kontrolem_controllers. It is the worked template a third party copies to add their own controller.
